Actually "long weekend" means a holiday that falls on a weekday (Mon-Fri) that extends the weekend. Typically if a holiday falls on Thursday or Friday, you can take the following days off to create a long weekend. Or if it falls on Tuesday or Wednesday, you might take preceding days. But the user likely wants all holidays that create a long weekend. Usually a long weekend occurs when a holiday falls on a Friday or Monday, giving a 3-day weekend.
